headline: Premier League recap: Arsenal kick off season with win over Coventry
description: The 2026-27 Premier League season kicked off with defending champions Arsenal beating newly promoted Coventry City 3-0 at the Emirates.

headline: Arsenal rout Coventry to start Premier League title defence
description: Arsenal made light work of Premier League new boys Coventry City as they began their title defence with a statement 3-0 win at the Emirates Stadium on Friday.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United looking at move for Barça's Balde
description: Manchester United are looking into the possibility of signing defender Alejandro Balde from Barcelona. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man United agree to £70m deal for Brighton's Carlos Baleba - sources
description: Manchester United have agreed to a deal with Brighton for midfielder Carlos Baleba, sources confirmed to ESPN.

headline: Summer transfer window: Grading big signings in men's soccer
description: The 2026 summer transfer window is open. Here is how we rated the biggest deals.

headline: Inter Milan sign Curtis Jones signing from Liverpool
description: Inter Milan have completed the signing of Liverpool midfielder Curtis Jones on a five-year contract, the Italian champions announced Friday.
